summary: Iter247: Validated three FortexaRH changes — (1) i18n fix for employees.valorManualMensualHelp now renders translated text on EmployeeFormDialog → Deductions tab (no raw key visible). (2) Login latency dramatically improved by background-task offload — median 285ms across 3 logins (well under 700ms target). (3) MongoDB indexes for login_history and trusted_devices verified present. New-location email alert helper safely no-ops when RESEND_API_KEY is absent (try/except confirmed). All regression tests pass: test_login_audit.py 13/13 + test_2fa_totp.py 10/10 + new iter247 perf tests 5/5 = 28/28 (100%).

issues: Action button '+ AGREGAR DESCUENTO' is hardcoded in Spanish — should be translated. Unrelated to current bug fix, minor i18n gap.

critical_code_review_comments: login_audit.py: log_login_attempt is now a sync wrapper that schedules _persist_login_attempt via BackgroundTasks — correctly removes the geo-lookup blocking from the auth path. Falls back to asyncio.create_task when BackgroundTasks is None (e.g., legacy call sites) — good defensive design.

login_audit.py: _send_new_location_alert correctly imports `resend` lazily inside try/except, early-returns when RESEND_API_KEY env var is missing, and the whole function is wrapped in try/except so failures only log warnings — safe in dev/test environments.
login_audit.py: new-location check uses (city, country_code) tuple and only fires for users who already have prior successful logins — protects against first-login false positives.
Indexes created idempotently on startup via setup_login_audit_indexes(); APScheduler purge job runs daily at 03:00 UTC.
i18n: employees.valorManualMensualHelp now present in all 4 locales (en, es, fr, pt); TRANSLATION_VERSION bumped to 3.7.9; locales endpoint serves the new key correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (i18n hint banner renders correctly on Deductions tab)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing employee records and login_history
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter247 backend regression test runners must export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and FORTEXA_RATE_LOGIN=1000/minute before running pytest. The new perf test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter247_login_audit_perf.py needs to be run with cwd=/app/backend so the `routes` module import resolves (it inserts ../../backend into sys.path but cwd matters for pytest rootdir). Verified MongoDB indexes via motor on live DB: login_history has user_id_1_created_at_-1 and created_at_-1; trusted_devices has user_id_1_revoked_1_expires_at_-1 and token_hash_1. Login median latency dropped to ~285ms (was multi-second when geo-lookup blocked). New-location alert path is code-review verified; no live email triggered because the test admin already has prior logins from his existing city, which is the correct behaviour.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration
